newsitem.title: UK: Moody's cuts three Santander bond funds ratings.
newsitem.headline: Moody's cuts three Santander bond funds ratings.

text.p: Moody's Investor Service has lowered the bond fund ratings of the Santander Fondtesoro (FIM), Santander Futuro (FIM), and Superfondo Sanatander (FIM) (the Funds) to Aa from Aaa.
"These rating actions conclude a review initiated on February 4, 1997," Moody's said in a statement. "The Funds are Spanish open-ended bond funds (FIM), managed by Gesbansander."

Moody's said the rating downgrade was the result of the Funds' continuing policy to invest to a large extent in Spanish government debt. The peseta- denominated bonds issued by the Kingdom of Spain were recently rated at Aa2.
"However...the fund manager's ability to maintain a high level of liquidity to meet redemption needs is not in question," the agency said.
